content:
RAKwireless has just launched the WisGate Connect Router RAK7392 (not to be confused with the older WisGate Connect RAK7391), an industrial-grade edge router and gateway built around Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4/5 (CM4/CM5). The system features three Gigabit Ethernet ports, one 2.5GbE port, wireless expansion via a mini PCIe slot, and WisBlock connectors for sensors and I/O modules. The gateway is designed for industrial IoT applications such as edge computing, VPN, Modbus-to-MQTT conversion, and LoRaWAN packet forwarding, eliminating the need for multiple boards and USB adapters for complex deployments. WisGate Connect Router RAK7392 specifications: SoM options (one or the other) Raspberry Pi CM4 – Broadcom BCM2711 quad-core Cortex-A72 processor @ 1.5 GHz Raspberry Pi CM5 – Broadcom BCM2712 quad-core Cortex-A76 processor @ 2.4 GHz Storage and Memory will depend upon the module Storage – MicroSD card socket for CM4/CM5 Lite modules only Networking 3x Gigabit Ethernet ports (eth1, eth2, eth3) [...]
